objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other controlled content items subject to lifecycle management.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level (1–4) indicating the document's position in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Free-text title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration (default 3 years) before validity must be re-confirmed.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period (default 10 years) after invalidation before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications attribute.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas to which the document applies.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: In a multi-client system, the clients in which the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document; released together with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status mirroring the main document's release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-controlled document added to a main document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional info has been directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal request proposing changes to an existing released document, managed independently of the document's version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it together with its attachments.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document processes in one or more roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System/license role assigned to the user (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution list membership.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, or location-specific group.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Per-document list of user groups and individual persons who are notified or asked for acknowledgement upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that orchestrates approval, validity extension, override, reactivation or acknowledgement steps.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature recorded by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the signature was provided (Creator, Review, Release).

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was recorded.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format of the template (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (e.g. department, location) to which documents or processes can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated Office editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator–Review–Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the review step.

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to addressed readers.

attributes.name: release_outcome
attributes.description: Positive release or rejection.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, cancelling remaining workflow tasks.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: Step at which rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for the new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Non-controlled additional information is added to a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted from a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal; the proposal creator is notified.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Releasers (and optionally authors/reviewers) process the validity extension request via workflow, confirming ongoing validity.

attributes.name: extension_outcome
attributes.description: Validity extended or revision/override initiated.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's Valid Until date is updated by the default validity period upon successful processing of the validity extension request.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow (releaser-only or 3-step with initiator, reviewer, releaser).

attributes.name: override_outcome
attributes.description: Override confirmed or rejected.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: The document and its attachments are declared out of force; all authorizations except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, restoring a new version with prior metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read or change).

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to or removed from a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Email or acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Email notifications are sent to distribution list members upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Distribution list members assigned for acknowledgement are sent an email requesting active confirmation upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is reviewed and released via a workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or distribution events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (workflow task, release info, acknowledgement request, validity extension info, override info).

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments that follow its release cycle.
A document can have one or more non-controlled additional information items.
A change proposal belongs to exactly one document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity it checks.
An override request is linked to the document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references the archived document to be reactivated.
Documents can reference other documents (e.g. local extension referencing original in multi-client setup).
A document can be created based on a template defined for its document type.
Each document has a distribution list defining who is notified or must acknowledge upon release.
A document can be linked to a business process for process-specific filing.
A document can be linked to organizational units.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members receive notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
A distribution list can contain individual users directly.
A user group contains one or more users who share authorization or distribution assignments.
User groups can have subgroups (e.g. location-specific reader subgroups).
Users are assigned to documents in roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translator.
User groups (e.g. Reader group, Archive group) are assigned to documents for authorization control.
